description: Get the resolutions one test case runs at on a lane, primary first, with its runSettings records and run strategy. Response shape: { projectId, testCaseId, runEnvironmentType, hasOwnTestSpec, displayResolutions, primaryResolution, featureFlags, runStrategy, runSettingsList: [{ runSettingsId, resolutionLabel, displayResolution, isPrimary }] }. hasOwnTestSpec false means the test case follows the project lane's resolutions. Change them with muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-update.

runEnvironmentType.description: Lane: 'remote' (cloud runs, the default) or 'local' (developer localhost).

name: muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-get
